# Write an ADR

1. Find the next number: list `docs/adr/` and add 1 to the highest number. Use four digits, for example `0007`.
2. Name the file `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md`. Use lowercase words with hyphens.
3. Use the ADR template from the skill `magenta:templates`.
4. Write one decision in each ADR.
5. Set the status: Proposed. Only the human changes it to Accepted.
6. If the ADR replaces an older ADR, link both. Change the old status to "Superseded by NNNN" only after the human accepts the new ADR.
